children: The marketing leader moves from Unilever to focus on brand building, product innovation and business growth at the premium dairy company

Mansi M. joined Epigamia as Head of Marketing in October 2026, moving from Unilever after more than nine years with the consumer goods company. With over 14 years of experience across Britannia, Airtel and Unilever, her career spans sales and distribution, trade marketing, brand management and business leadership. At Epigamia, she will focus on strengthening the brand, driving innovation, expanding digital and e-commerce capabilities, and building the marketing team as the company pursues its ambition of becoming India’s most preferred premium value-added dairy brand.

Before joining Epigamia, Mansi led brand and business growth for OZiva at Unilever as Senior Marketing Manager from August 2025 to October 2026. Her responsibilities included brand positioning, product development, campaign strategy, e-commerce and quick commerce growth, and pricing and profitability decisions. She also held P&L responsibility, balancing brand investment with commercial performance.

Between August 2023 and August 2025, she worked as Brand Manager for OZiva, leading a packaging and visual identity transformation, portfolio premiumisation and offline expansion. Her work included developing the route-to-market strategy, channel-specific portfolios and pricing architecture to support the brand’s expansion beyond online channels.

Mansi joined Unilever in 2017 after working at Airtel as Product Manager and Assistant Manager for Sales and Distribution. At Unilever, she held roles in key account management and trade marketing before becoming Area Sales Manager for the pharmaceutical channel in August 2021.

In that role, she established the company’s pharmaceutical channel model, building its go-to-market structure, distributor network, organisational design and sales processes. She also led a cross-functional team of key account executives and territory leads as the model expanded nationally.
Earlier, she worked at Britannia Industries in trade marketing and sales development from 2012 to 2014, focusing on point-of-sale initiatives, distribution expansion and go-to-market planning.

At Epigamia, Mansi’s remit includes developing campaigns and storytelling to strengthen brand distinctiveness, identifying opportunities for product innovation and improving the connection between consumer demand and e-commerce and digital commerce. She will also work on building a team focused on experimentation, execution and commercial outcomes.

Her stated approach to marketing emphasises combining creativity with measurable business impact, using data and experience to inform decisions while remaining open to new ideas. Her transition brings experience across established consumer brands and a wellness business to Epigamia as it seeks to expand its reach in the value-added dairy market.

The appointment marks a shift from leading the growth of a wellness brand within a large consumer goods organisation to taking on a marketing leadership role at a dedicated food brand, with brand building and business growth forming the core of her new responsibilities.
